Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

phone — a telephone. Example: I have got a new phone.
computer — a machine for storing and using data. Example: We use the computer at home.
internet — the world network of computers. Example: I search for information on the internet.
online — connected to the internet. Example: I am online two hours a day.
message — a short piece of communication. Example: I send ten messages a day.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I have got a ...
• I am online ... hours a day.
• I send messages every morning.
• I never use my phone at night.
• Thank you for listening.

Grammar focus: Imperatives for tech instructions.
Present your tech life in three parts: devices, activities and habits. Use have got and the present simple: I have got a phone. I am online two hours a day. I send messages every morning.
